The nominal component of Ti80 alloy is Ti –6Al–3Nb–2Zr–1Mo. Ti80 alloy is one of the 850 MPa-level corrosion resistant near alpha titanium alloys of China.

Commercially pure titanium and its alloys were attractive materials in industrial and biomedical applications owing to their good corrosion resistance, mechanical properties, chemical stability and biocompatibility in the human body [ 1, 2].
